title: Stack Scout // Updates
summary: Public-safe activity stream seeded from official or first-party sources.

items.title: Science Corporation’s brain tech is worth $3.5 billion after new funding
items.summary: Science Corp raised a $400 million Series D to scale up its anti-blindness business.

items.title: Nvidia’s first big move after Jensen Huang’s exit targets national security
items.summary: The new standing committee will give board-level oversight of national security policies, export control compliance, and global trade risks, the company said.

items.title: GPT and Claude give the appendix a starring role in paper reviews, preprint reports
items.summary: A preprint reports appendix-heavy AI critiques, but different classification prompts complicate its comparison with human reviewers.

items.title: Harness Hub sends Qwen3.8-27B to Pi school, reports 55–62% fewer benchmark tool calls
items.summary: Harness Hub reports higher success rates for its Pi-specific Qwen3.8-27B adapter, with thinking off and benchmark-informed checkpoint selection.

items.title: Spotify’s new tool aims to stop deepfakes from being attributed to real artists
items.summary: The update comes as Billboard reported last month that Sony Music had requested the removal of more than 260,000 deepfake songs from digital platforms, nearly double the number the label disclosed in March.

items.title: Anthropic's advice for AI agents: Don't copy the org chart
items.summary: The company recommends testing fewer subagents, citing frequent quality gains and often lower costs and latency in enterprise comparisons.

items.title: Isomorphic Labs announces a $5 billion bet on AI-designed medicines
items.summary: Greenoaks and Sequoia co-led the Series C, with Alphabet and Andreessen Horowitz among the backers, the company says.

items.title: Posts report Megaspeed probe details and Nvidia’s new export control committee
items.summary: DivesTech says Commerce and DOJ released Megaspeed export probe details; StockSavvyShay says Nvidia formed an export control oversight committee.

items.title: Google says hackers’ AI can read the fix, then launch the exploit
items.summary: Google says exploit_agent analyzes patches, writes attack code and runs it without human intervention, potentially squeezing defenders’ time to update.

items.title: LM Studio announces Agent Remote Control. Your other computer has work to do.
items.summary: Launch posts describe Bionic agents running on other devices while you manage them from a laptop.

items.title: DHS secretary suggests AI link to US outages, Kalshi reports
items.summary: Kalshi reports that the DHS secretary says AI may be behind recent outages in the US.

items.title: Cybersecurity AI startup Corma reaches $1B valuation in about 3 months
items.summary: Three months since introducing its product, AI cybersecurity startup Corba has raised a $125 million Series A at a $1 billion valuation led by NEA.

items.title: All the questions Nvidia should answer on Tuesday — but probably won’t
items.summary: Nvidia interim CEO and longtime CFO Colette Kress is about to have one of the biggest days of her career on Tuesday when the company reports its third-quarter results. Given the turmoil Nvidia is in, there are a number of questions that Nvidia should answer.

items.title: California state AG sues OpenAI over rogue agent incidents
items.summary: The California lawsuit represents one of the first attempts to hold an AI lab legally accountable for a rogue agent incident.

items.title: Trump says ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy did not threaten national security
items.summary: Trump contradicted his own government's intelligence officials, who reportedly concluded that Alice Huang is a Chinese spy.

items.title: Make opened its CLI to all users
items.summary: Make's 2026 release notes show the Make CLI becoming available to all users, continuing the platform's expansion beyond the browser UI.

items.title: GitHub MCP Server reached 1.0.0
items.summary: The official GitHub MCP server hit 1.0.0 with granular issue field tooling and broader MCP Apps support behind feature flags.

items.title: GitHub CLI 2.90.0 introduced `gh skill` in public preview
items.summary: The latest GitHub CLI release adds search, install, preview, update, and publish flows for portable agent skills.

items.title: Hugging Face added Kernels to the Hub
items.summary: The Hub changelog added Kernels as a new way to browse precompiled, hardware-specific kernels and also continues to push agent traces into the product story.

items.title: Strudel Studio's latest public pass focused on smoke-run reliability
items.summary: The recent manager-side pass caught and fixed a release-smoke issue while keeping the studio workflow moving forward.

items.title: Canvas Planner stayed clean and review-ready in its latest public pass
items.summary: The latest public-ready manager pass kept the board surface fast and uncluttered while tightening browser behavior.

items.title: Playwright MCP 0.0.70 landed as the latest maintenance release
items.summary: The current tagged release is a maintenance cut, while the docs continue to push Playwright MCP as a first-class browser layer for agent workflows.

items.title: n8n kept its March 2026 release line moving
items.summary: The March release notes show continued 1.12x shipping, while docs and blog updates highlight secrets-provider and workflow-hardening work.

items.title: OpenAI launched GPT-5.4
items.summary: GPT-5.4 arrived with native computer use, tool search, and 1M-token context, reinforcing OpenAI's focus on real agent workflows.

items.title: Perplexity doubled down on its product thesis in March 2026
items.summary: Perplexity's public blog framed 'The AI is the Computer' and kept tying that story to its API and device ambitions from late February.

items.title: Anthropic's current system-card set centers Claude Sonnet 4.6
items.summary: Anthropic's model materials list Claude Sonnet 4.6 as the current Sonnet generation and explicitly note API access among the active surfaces.

items.title: Wrangler 4.58.0 improved command grouping and auth ergonomics
items.summary: Cloudflare's Workers SDK release added grouped help categories, better auth token retrieval, and type generation on dev startup.
